options.content:
# OpenStack Soak Test Showcase
Static dashboard for showcasing OpenStack soak-test runs from existing Prometheus metrics. It uses node exporter, libvirt exporter, OVS exporter, Ceph mgr/exporter, and OpenStack exporter metrics where available. No soak-tester artifacts or runtime integration are required.

Set `run_id` and `project` to regexes when OpenStack/libvirt metadata exposes them. Keep defaults as `.*` for broad infrastructure views. Use `instance`, `hypervisor`, `domain`, `network_device`, `storage_device`, `ceph_pool`, and `ceph_osd` to narrow noisy panels during a run.

Host and exporter counters may include encapsulation, retransmits, and non-test traffic. Treat these panels as infrastructure-side evidence, not exact workload goodput. Workload tools such as iperf3 and fio remain the source for guest-observed goodput.

panels.title: Nova API up
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_nova_up`; 1 means exporter could query Nova.

panels.title: Neutron API up
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_neutron_up`; 1 means exporter could query Neutron.

panels.title: Cinder API up
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_cinder_up`; 1 means exporter could query Cinder.

panels.title: Keystone API up
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_identity_up`; 1 means exporter could query Keystone/Identity.

panels.title: Running VMs
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_nova_running_vms`, grouped across hypervisors. More reliable in this datasource than per-server status.

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: OpenStack exporter Keystone project count from `openstack_identity_projects`.

panels.title: Nova instances by status
panels.description: Uses `openstack_nova_server_status` if per-server status is exposed; this may show no data on exporters that only expose aggregate VM counts.

panels.title: Cinder volumes by status
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_cinder_volume_status`; filters by volume name/run id and tenant/project id where labels exist. Counts are colored by status, not magnitude: many healthy volumes are not inherently bad.

panels.title: Neutron ports by status
panels.description: OpenStack exporter `openstack_neutron_port`, grouped by Neutron port status.

panels.title: OpenStack services
panels.description: Exporter-dependent service/agent table. Uses `_total` agent-state metrics observed in this datasource.

panels.title: Quota and placement resource usage
panels.description: OpenStack exporter quota and Placement resource metrics where available. Useful for growth trends during a soak run.

panels.title: Libvirt domains by state
panels.description: Libvirt exporter `libvirt_domain_info_vstate` or state metric. Numeric state values are exporter/libvirt dependent.

panels.title: Top domain CPU usage
panels.description: Libvirt domain CPU seconds as cores used. Joined to `libvirt_domain_info_meta` for project and instance names when available.

targets.expr: topk(10, rate(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, domain) group_left(project_name, instance_name, uuid, flavor) libvirt_domain_info_meta{project_name=~"$project", instance_name=~".*$run_id.*"})

panels.title: Domain memory usage
panels.description: Libvirt exporter memory usage and maximum memory. Panels may show no data if memory metrics are not exported.

targets.expr: libvirt_domain_info_memory_usage_bytes{domain=~"$domain"} * on (instance, domain) group_left(project_name, instance_name, uuid, flavor) libvirt_domain_info_meta{project_name=~"$project", instance_name=~".*$run_id.*"}

libvirt_domain_info_maximum_memory_bytes{domain=~"$domain"} * on (instance, domain) group_left(project_name, instance_name, uuid, flavor) libvirt_domain_info_meta{project_name=~"$project", instance_name=~".*$run_id.*"}

panels.title: Domain network RX/TX
panels.description: Libvirt domain interface bytes converted to bits/sec. Host and exporter counters may include encapsulation, retransmits, and non-test traffic. Treat these panels as infrastructure-side evidence, not exact workload goodput.

panels.title: Domain block throughput
panels.description: Libvirt block read/write throughput from domain block stats.

panels.title: Domain block IOPS
panels.description: Libvirt block read/write request counters as operations/sec.

panels.title: Domain network drops/errors
panels.description: Libvirt domain interface drop/error counters when available.

panels.title: Domains matching filters
panels.description: Libvirt metadata table. Shows project, instance name, UUID, flavor, and domain labels when `libvirt_domain_info_meta` is exported.

panels.title: CPU utilization by host
panels.description: Node exporter CPU utilization from non-idle CPU seconds.

panels.title: CPU mode breakdown
panels.description: Node exporter CPU mode rates excluding idle.

panels.title: Load average by host
panels.description: Node exporter 1/5/15 minute load averages.

panels.title: Memory used percent
panels.description: Node exporter memory used percentage from MemAvailable/MemTotal.

panels.title: Swap usage
panels.description: Node exporter swap used percentage. Empty when swap metrics are unavailable or swap is disabled.

panels.title: Disk pressure / iowait
panels.description: Node exporter CPU iowait percentage by host.

panels.title: Filesystem usage
panels.description: Node exporter filesystem usage excluding transient filesystems.

panels.title: Top hosts by CPU/memory/iowait
panels.description: Current top risk hosts from node exporter CPU, memory, and iowait metrics.

panels.title: Physical NIC RX
panels.description: Physical host NIC receive throughput only. Excludes bonds, bridges, VLAN devices, tunnels, tap/veth/LXC devices, and loopback to avoid counting the same packet at multiple Linux networking layers.

panels.title: Physical NIC TX
panels.description: Physical host NIC transmit throughput only. Excludes bonds, bridges, VLAN devices, tunnels, tap/veth/LXC devices, and loopback to avoid counting the same packet at multiple Linux networking layers.

panels.title: VM vNIC RX+TX
panels.description: Guest-facing virtual NIC throughput from libvirt domain counters. This is the VM edge view and should not be added to physical NIC or OVS interface totals.

panels.title: NIC drops/errors
panels.description: Node exporter interface drops and errors/sec for selected devices.

panels.title: Physical NIC RX/TX by host
panels.description: Physical host NIC throughput by host. This is the wire-side view and intentionally excludes virtual and overlay devices.

panels.title: Physical NIC RX/TX by host and device
panels.description: Per-physical-NIC wire throughput. Use this panel to validate whether any physical NIC approaches line rate.

panels.title: Packets/sec
panels.description: Node exporter packet counters for selected host NICs.

panels.title: Drops/sec by host/device
panels.description: Node exporter receive+transmit drops/sec.

panels.title: Errors/sec by host/device
panels.description: Node exporter receive+transmit errors/sec.

panels.title: OVS interface RX/TX
panels.description: OVS interface counters are a virtual switching breakdown. Do not sum this panel with physical NIC or VM vNIC totals; the same packet can appear on patch, tunnel, bridge, and VM-facing interfaces.

targets.expr: sum by (system_id, name) (rate(ovs_interface_rx_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) * 8 * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface)
sum by (system_id, name) (rate(ovs_interface_tx_bytes_total[$__rate_interval]) * 8 * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface)

panels.title: OVS interface packets/sec
panels.description: OVS exporter packet counters joined to interface names where available.

targets.expr: sum by (system_id, name) (rate(ovs_interface_rx_packets_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface)
sum by (system_id, name) (rate(ovs_interface_tx_packets_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface)

panels.title: OVS drops/errors
panels.description: OVS exporter interface dropped/error counters. Metric names vary; this dashboard uses the `_total` counters found in current ovs exporter builds.

targets.expr: sum by (system_id, name) ((rate(ovs_interface_rx_dropped_total[$__rate_interval]) + rate(ovs_interface_tx_dropped_total[$__rate_interval]) + rate(ovs_interface_rx_errors_total[$__rate_interval]) + rate(ovs_interface_tx_errors_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface)

panels.title: OVS interface state
panels.description: OVS exporter interface admin/link state where available.

targets.expr: ovs_interface_admin_state * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface or ovs_interface_link_state * on (system_id, uuid) group_left(name) ovs_interface

panels.title: OVS datapath flows/lookups
panels.description: OVS exporter datapath flow count and lookup hit/miss/lost counters.

panels.title: Libvirt domain block read throughput
panels.description: Libvirt domain block read bytes/sec.

panels.title: Libvirt domain block write throughput
panels.description: Libvirt domain block write bytes/sec.

panels.title: Libvirt domain block IOPS
panels.description: Libvirt domain block read/write requests/sec.

panels.title: Node disk throughput by device
panels.description: Node exporter disk read/write bytes/sec by selected device.

panels.title: Node disk IOPS
panels.description: Node exporter completed read/write operations/sec by device.

panels.title: Node disk IO time utilization proxy
panels.description: Node exporter `node_disk_io_time_seconds_total` as an IO busy-time proxy. Values can exceed 100% for some device mappings and should be treated as a pressure indicator.

panels.title: Ceph health status
panels.description: Ceph mgr Prometheus module `ceph_health_status`: commonly 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=ERR.

panels.title: OSDs up
panels.description: Ceph `ceph_osd_up` count.

panels.title: OSDs in
panels.description: Ceph `ceph_osd_in` count.

panels.title: OSDs down/out
panels.description: Ceph OSDs down or out from boolean comparisons.

panels.title: Degraded objects
panels.description: Ceph degraded object count if exported.

panels.title: Slow ops
panels.description: Ceph slow operation healthcheck metric if exported.

panels.title: PG states
panels.description: Ceph PG state metrics from mgr Prometheus module.

panels.title: Recovery/backfill activity
panels.description: Ceph pool recovery/backfill throughput and object/key rates when available.

panels.title: Monitor quorum and health details
panels.description: Ceph monitor quorum and health detail metrics where available.

panels.title: Ceph read throughput
panels.description: Ceph pool read bytes/sec from `_total` counters, with fallback for older names.

panels.title: Ceph write throughput
panels.description: Ceph pool write bytes/sec from `_total` counters, with fallback for older names.

panels.title: Ceph read IOPS
panels.description: Ceph pool read operations/sec.

panels.title: Ceph write IOPS
panels.description: Ceph pool write operations/sec.

panels.title: Pool read/write throughput
panels.description: Ceph pool throughput by pool name when `ceph_pool_metadata` is available.

panels.title: Pool IOPS
panels.description: Ceph pool read/write operations/sec by pool name.

panels.title: OSD op latency
panels.description: Ceph OSD apply/commit latency in milliseconds when exported.

panels.title: Pool capacity used
panels.description: Ceph pool percent used by pool name.

panels.title: Cluster capacity used
panels.description: Ceph cluster used/total capacity percentage.

panels.title: Service up signals
panels.description: OpenStack exporter service reachability signals. Exporter-dependent but common for openstack-exporter deployments.

panels.title: Agent/service state
panels.description: OpenStack exporter Nova, Neutron, and Cinder agent-state metrics. Metric labels vary across exporter versions.

panels.title: Hypervisor allocation
panels.description: OpenStack exporter Nova hypervisor vCPU/RAM/local disk allocation metrics.

panels.title: Quota usage
panels.description: OpenStack exporter quota metrics where exposed by Nova and Cinder.

panels.title: Hosts above 90% CPU
panels.description: Node exporter count of selected hosts above 90% CPU utilization.

targets.expr: count((100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) > 90) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hosts above 90% memory
panels.description: Node exporter count of selected hosts above 90% memory used.

panels.title: Interfaces drops/errors
panels.description: Node exporter selected interface drops/errors per second.

panels.title: Disks high IO pressure
panels.description: Node exporter count of selected devices above 80% IO busy-time proxy.

panels.title: Ceph OSDs down/out
panels.description: Ceph OSD risk count from up/in metrics.

panels.title: Ceph degraded PGs
panels.description: Ceph degraded PG count.

panels.title: Top noisy VMs/domains
panels.description: Top libvirt domains by CPU, network, and storage activity. Joined to metadata where available.

targets.expr: topk(20, rate(libvirt_domain_info_cpu_time_seconds_total{domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, domain) group_left(project_name, instance_name, uuid, flavor) libvirt_domain_info_meta{project_name=~"$project", instance_name=~".*$run_id.*"})

topk(20, (sum by (instance, domain) (rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_receive_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(libvirt_domain_interface_stats_transmit_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance, domain) group_left(project_name, instance_name, uuid, flavor) libvirt_domain_info_meta{project_name=~"$project", instance_name=~".*$run_id.*"})

topk(20, (sum by (instance, domain) (rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_bytes_total{domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance, domain) group_left(project_name, instance_name, uuid, flavor) libvirt_domain_info_meta{project_name=~"$project", instance_name=~".*$run_id.*"})

panels.title: OpenStack services down
panels.description: Exporter-dependent table of down OpenStack services/agents. Uses agent-state metrics where available.

list.name: run_id
list.label: Run ID regex
list.description: Regex for soak_tester_run_id if exposed by metrics, or leave .*.

list.name: project
list.label: Project regex
list.description: OpenStack project name/id regex where exposed by metrics.

list.name: plane
list.label: Plane
list.description: Optional soak_tester_plane value where exposed by metrics.
list.query: all : .*,compute : compute,network : network,storage : storage,api : api,control : control

list.name: role
list.label: Role
list.description: Optional soak_tester_role value where exposed by metrics.

list.name: hypervisor
list.label: Hypervisor
list.description: Hypervisor hostnames from OpenStack exporter or node exporter.

list.name: network_device
list.label: Network device
list.description: Node network device label. Default regex excludes loopback/container/tap/bridge noise in panel queries, but this variable can override selection.

list.name: storage_device
list.label: Storage device
list.description: Node disk device label. Default regex excludes loop/ram/device-mapper noise but allows override.

list.name: ceph_pool
list.label: Ceph pool
list.description: Ceph pool names from ceph_pool_metadata where available.

list.name: ceph_osd
list.label: Ceph OSD
list.description: Ceph OSD daemon labels from ceph_osd_up.

list.name: interval
list.label: Interval
list.description: Panel interval selector for manual ad hoc queries; panels use $__rate_interval by default.
